cases.name: order is exact lexicographic and prefix first
cases.document:
kernel 1
numbers by_spelling
use compare = @0e53c62151487bcea62cb8db985915d52c96f7c519eab3c26afd8d598b8b585b
main { let a = clock let b = clock finish [compare(9007199254740993, 9007199254740992.0), compare(b"ff", b"ff00"), compare(false, true), compare((1, 2,), (1, 3,)), compare([1], [1, 0]), compare(a, b)] }
